scope: Repository evidence only; no new external acquisition.

discovery_contract.rule: Preserve and display every source-addressable signal. Evidence state changes an edge's label, weight, and line style; it never makes the edge invisible.
discovery_contract.public_use: Researchers, journalists, reviewers, and members of the public can inspect convergences, discontinuities, repeated institutions, personnel relays, capital paths, and missing joins, then evaluate what questions the pattern raises.
discovery_contract.adjudication_boundary: Canonical hop eligibility controls only the asserted Clifford Number graph. It does not control discovery visibility.

cross_corpus_infrastructure.purpose: Expose the full publicly inspectable discovery corpus that surrounds this principal-focused trail, including staged and intake-only defense, capital, award, personnel, and disclosure lanes.
cross_corpus_infrastructure.visibility_rule: A lane cannot disappear because its graph_effect is none, its promotion gate is held, or its acquisition state is incomplete.

matt-clifford.supported_summary: The ledger supports Clifford's official Action Plan development role, the separately bounded publication-and-response hop to Keir Starmer, and the official Faculty company overlap. His Dialog public-directory listing and separately reported invitation/non-attendance remain scorable, graph-inert observations; neither supplies a shared surface with Peter Thiel.
matt-clifford.prohibited_extension: Policy authorship, directory listing, or invitation without attendance does not transfer participation into unrelated procurement, capital, political, or interpersonal surfaces.

peter-thiel.corpus_role: canonical actor with one reported organizational-role observation
peter-thiel.supported_summary: The authoritative surface ledger preserves WIRED's exact-date report that Thiel was a Dialog co-founder. Clifford appears on separate directory and invitation/non-attendance observations, so the compiled topology documents no eligible shared-surface path between them.
peter-thiel.prohibited_extension: A reported organizational role, Clifford's separate directory listing, sector prominence, Founders Fund affiliation, or Palantir association does not create a Clifford hop or policy/procurement coordination edge.

donald-trump.corpus_role: officeholder/disclosure cohort member, not a surface-ledger participant
donald-trump.supported_summary: The repository has substantial Trump disclosure and campaign-finance intake, but its identity, beneficial-interest, and temporal gates currently promote no office-business crossing.
donald-trump.prohibited_extension: A brand, property, payee-name, committee, business, or family-company reference cannot be transferred to Donald Trump personally without the required predicate and identity evidence.

surviving_outcomes.outcome: Official records place Clifford on the Action Plan commission and development work, then place Clifford and Starmer together only on the 13 January 2025 publication and government-response surface where the government said it would take forward all 50 recommendations.
Official records place Clifford as a Faculty Science shareholder and Marc Warner and Saul Klein as directors of the same company on 10 October 2024.
surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: The company surface proves concurrent formal roles only. It does not prove contact, operational participation, influence over company or government decisions, procurement involvement, agreement, coordination, motive, wrongdoing, or common purpose.

surviving_outcomes.outcome: The plan recommends sovereign compute, AI Growth Zones, a National Data Library, procurement reform, government as a strategic AI customer, domestic AI champions, and deeper national-security collaboration.
surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: These are documented recommendations and government commitments; each downstream implementation, beneficiary, contract, or causal effect requires its own receipt.

surviving_outcomes.outcome: Repository research records Thiel as a Palantir co-founder and chair since 2003.
surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: The generic governance role does not establish personal control of a particular subsidiary, award, procurement decision, or government action.

path: Maven / Army enterprise agreement / NATO deployment
surviving_outcomes.outcome: The corpus records a reported $480 million Maven prototype, Maven becoming a program of record, an Army enterprise agreement up to $10 billion over ten years, and NATO supply.
surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: These records establish Palantir's state-facing footprint, not that Clifford, Starmer, or Thiel caused any particular award.

surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: This is a Palantir-Army personnel surface, not a Peter Thiel appointment or a Clifford hop.

surviving_outcomes.outcome: The ledger records Louis Mosley, identified as a Palantir EVP, as a reported Electric Twin angel investor; Electric Twin was founded by former No. 10 personnel and commercializes synthetic-audience infrastructure.
surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: This is a reported person-to-company investment and occupational descriptor, not Palantir corporate investment, Thiel control, or Clifford coordination.

path: Dialog public-directory listing plus reported invitation/non-attendance
surviving_outcomes.outcome: Clifford is listed in Dialog's public directory and is separately reported as an invitee who had not attended, while Thiel is separately reported as a co-founder.
surviving_outcomes.interpretation_limit: These are different propositions on different non-hop surfaces. They do not prove membership, attendance, a shared event, bilateral contact, agreement, transaction, influence, or coordination.

AI and defense supplier market including Palantir

composite_trails.open_join: The corpus does not yet identify a named Action Plan implementation contract, decision, or vehicle that joins Clifford or Starmer specifically to Palantir.

composite_trails.open_join: A governance role cannot be transferred into personal authorship, control, or causation of individual contracts or appointments.

composite_trails.open_join: No receipted attended event, bilateral interaction, or bounded shared participation currently joins Clifford and Thiel through Dialog.

observations: Clifford authored a plan adopted by Starmer that calls for sovereign compute, procurement reform, government as a strategic AI customer, domestic AI champions, and deeper national-security collaboration.
Palantir has a large reported state-procurement and military-deployment footprint through Maven, the Army enterprise agreement, NATO supply, and Detachment 201 personnel participation.
signals_outside_hop_graph.what_the_pattern_shows: A government demand-building program and a mature state-facing AI supplier ecosystem are expanding in the same historical window. The data makes that convergence visible even before a specific Action Plan-to-Palantir contract is found.
signals_outside_hop_graph.research_question: Which named implementation vehicles, procurement frameworks, advisers, or intermediaries turn the policy program into supplier outcomes?

observations: Former No. 10 personnel founded Electric Twin and commercialized synthetic-audience infrastructure.
Former Cabinet Secretary Simon Case joined its ethics board.
Louis Mosley, identified as a Palantir EVP, appears on its reported angel-investor surface.
The product is reported in use with News UK.
signals_outside_hop_graph.what_the_pattern_shows: Personnel, legitimacy, capital, and modeled-public-input capability circulate across government, AI infrastructure, media, and defense-adjacent occupational networks.
signals_outside_hop_graph.research_question: Is this an ordinary revolving-door market, a repeatable governance-production model, or both—and which exact transactions distinguish the cases?

observations: Sanabil is reported as PIF-owned and publicly lists Founders Fund as a fund partner.
Thiel is recorded in the research layer as a Founders Fund partner and Palantir co-founder/chair.
Palantir is recorded with major U.S. and NATO state-facing outcomes.
signals_outside_hop_graph.what_the_pattern_shows: Sovereign capital, venture management, company governance, and defense procurement appear in a continuous structural trail, although the exact LP vehicle, commitment, ownership window, and control rights remain open.
signals_outside_hop_graph.research_question: What legal vehicles, dates, amounts, and governance rights make the capital trail concrete?

observations: Dialog's exposed public directory lists Clifford among 112 actor identities and one organization-context row.
WIRED separately reports Thiel, Auren Hoffman, and Raffi Grinberg in three organizational roles and reports Clifford's statement that he had been invited and had not attended.
signals_outside_hop_graph.what_the_pattern_shows: The exposed directory spans policy, capital, technology, security, media, and law, but its density and mixed semantics prevent pairwise inference. The role and non-attendance observations remain visible without being converted into a convening event.
signals_outside_hop_graph.research_question: Which named, dated events or attendance records, if any, establish smaller shared-participation surfaces without treating the directory itself as one?

Thiel's co-founder role is a separate reported observation, and Donald Trump is not himself a participant in the surface ledger; the officeholder pipeline separately preserves campaign, disclosure, registry, and payee-name signals.
signals_outside_hop_graph.what_the_pattern_shows: Trump-administration and conservative legal/political figures appear in the dense directory, while the compiler refuses to turn that index or Thiel's separate role observation into Donald Trump or pairwise actor edges.
signals_outside_hop_graph.research_question: Which dated appointments, campaign vehicles, transactions, or event-level co-participations connect these administration-adjacent actors to the capital and policy trails?

The admitted surface proves concurrent formal relationships to the same company on one exact date, not contact, operational participation, influence, procurement involvement, agreement, coordination, motive, wrongdoing, or common purpose.

public_interpretation_contract.public_prompt: Follow the data across policy formation, state adoption, supplier markets, military channels, capital, personnel circulation, convening infrastructure, and administration-adjacent actors. Compare line styles; do not confuse a dotted edge with no edge.
locked_doors: A named and dated Clifford-Thiel co-investment, board, contract, or advisory surface
An identifier-resolved Thiel- or Clifford-linked legal entity in a Trump campaign, disclosure, appointment, or procurement record
A transaction-level receipt with compatible ownership and public-role intervals
Named, dated Dialog attendance records that establish bounded shared-participation surfaces
Exact vehicles, amounts, dates, and control rights in the Sanabil-Founders Fund capital trail
public_interpretation_contract.instruction: Locked doors are research objectives, not reasons to hide the corridors leading to them. The infrastructure supplies no final verdict.
